name: create_users
sql: CREATE TABLE users (id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(32), age INT)

name: reject_other_update
sql: UPDATE other SET age = 9 WHERE id = 1

name: select_ordered
sql: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 2

name: select_filtered_limit
sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE age > 25 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

name: select_count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE age >= 25

name: select_id_range
sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 2 ORDER BY id ASC

name: reject_invalid_number
sql: UPDATE users SET age = abc WHERE id = 1

name: update_age
sql: UPDATE users SET age = 31 WHERE name = 'O''Brien'

name: select_after_delete
sql: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id
